## Change

## Security and privacy

Describe affected trust boundaries, attacker-controlled inputs, metadata exposure,
failure behavior, and any residual risk. Write `No change` only when verified.

## Verification

- [ ] Formatting and lint pass.
- [ ] Unit/integration tests pass.
- [ ] Dependency lockfiles are unchanged or intentionally updated.

- [ ] Documentation and traceability are updated.
